origins.name: Freak Accident
origins.source: Something went wrong in exactly the right way.
origins.complication: Nobody can repeat it, including you, and somebody is liable.

origins.name: Mutant
origins.source: Born different; it arrived with a growth spurt or a fever.
origins.complication: Registries, stares and a body that keeps changing.

origins.name: Tech
origins.complication: Parts, batteries, patents and someone else's invoices.

origins.name: Magic
origins.source: Studied, bargained for or inherited from something old.
origins.complication: Every spell has terms, and the terms have a memory.

origins.name: Alien / Dimensional
origins.source: From somewhere else, or touched by it.
origins.complication: Home rules do not apply here, and home may come looking.

origins.name: Psychic
origins.source: A mind that reaches past the skull.
origins.complication: You always hear a little more than you wanted to.

affinities.name: Fire
affinities.risk: Smoke, burns and tempers that do not cool on schedule

affinities.name: Air
affinities.risk: Falls, gusts and people swept somewhere they did not choose

affinities.name: Earth
affinities.risk: Collapses, blocked exits and foundations that never quite settle

affinities.name: Water
affinities.risk: Floods, drownings and currents that pull in two directions

affinities.name: Discipline
affinities.theme: Training, mastery and a body that obeys.
affinities.risk: Overtraining, rigidity and the temptation to demand obedience

affinities.name: Genius
affinities.risk: Arrogance, blind spots and solutions with people missing from them

affinities.name: Birthright
affinities.theme: Legacy, destiny and a mantle someone wore first.
affinities.risk: Expectations, inheritances and debts you never signed for

affinities.name: Social
affinities.risk: Consent, manipulation and never knowing who likes the real you

vows.name: Shelter
vows.promise: Defend the people nearest the danger even when the larger plan becomes harder.

vows.name: Unmask
vows.promise: Expose who controls a crisis, even when the truth ends a comfortable alliance.

vows.name: Claim
vows.promise: Seize direct command before somebody indecisive has a chance to spend lives.

powers.name: Pilot Light
powers.action: flare from ember-warm to blast-furnace in a single heartbeat
powers.cost: His temperature spikes and nobody can touch him for an hour
powers.prom: The ballroom kitchen gas lines are rigged beneath the dance floor.

powers.name: Updraft
powers.action: ride and shape the wind around her body to hover, glide and catch falling people
powers.cost: Her lungs burn and her ears ring for hours after a long flight
powers.prom: The glass roof is set to vent the ballroom air into the stratosphere.

powers.name: Bedrock
powers.action: turn his skin to granite and anchor himself so nothing can move him
powers.cost: Every hour as stone costs him a day of feeling in his hands
powers.prom: Old maintenance tunnels have been cut so the ballroom floor will drop into the dark.

powers.name: Undertow
powers.action: pull water out of pipes, puddles and the harbor into whips, walls and lifelines
powers.cost: She dehydrates fast and her lips crack blue
powers.prom: The sprinkler mains are pressurized to flood the sealed ballroom.

powers.name: Still Point
powers.action: perceive a single second as ten and move with perfect precision inside it
powers.cost: When time snaps back, a migraine knocks him flat
powers.prom: A timer in the chandelier counts down to a blackout with ninety seconds of chaos inside it.

powers.name: Overclock
powers.action: solve any equation, lock or machine schematic in seconds
powers.cost: She forgets ordinary things: names, birthdays, whether she has eaten
powers.prom: The ballroom security system has been rewritten into a puzzle lock with the guests inside.

powers.name: The Mantle
powers.action: let the living cape shield, glide and recall every fight his family ever won
powers.cost: The cape has opinions, and it remembers every fight the family lost too
powers.prom: The Valcourt trophy display above the stage is wired to fall on the crowned couple.

powers.name: Encore
powers.action: sing a crowd into calm, courage or a perfectly timed evacuation
powers.cost: Their own feelings go quiet until the echo fades
powers.prom: The prom band's speakers carry a signal that freezes every dancer in place.

powers.name: Rekindle
powers.action: burn through injury and rise again, healing herself and anyone she holds inside the flame
powers.cost: Every rebirth burns away one memory
powers.prom: The ballroom curtains are soaked in accelerant from the registry archive.

powers.name: Murmuration
powers.action: fly, and call the city's birds into sweeping shapes of warning and rescue
powers.cost: His bones are fragile, and a bad landing breaks them
powers.prom: Something has frightened every bird in the city into a storm against the ballroom glass.

powers.name: Seismic
powers.action: stomp shockwaves through the ground and feel every footstep within a city block
powers.cost: She breaks floors, cars and occasionally friendships by accident
powers.prom: The ballroom sits on a fault that someone has been drilling into for a month.

powers.name: Depth Charge
powers.action: swim at torpedo speed and push a pressure wave that flips boats or carries the drowning to shore
powers.cost: He must stay wet, or his skin cracks and bleeds
powers.prom: The harbor gates beneath the ballroom pier have been opened at high tide.

powers.name: Fourfold
powers.action: fight, climb, juggle and catch with four arms in perfect coordination
powers.cost: Her shoulders lock into spasms after a long fight
powers.prom: Prom security has been issued weapons that were sold to the villain's crew the week before.

powers.name: Foresight Engine
powers.action: model a situation so precisely they can predict what everyone will do next
powers.cost: Every prediction brings a headache, and the headaches are getting worse
powers.prom: Every exit has been predicted and blocked in the order the guests will try them.

powers.name: Halo
powers.action: shed protective light from her wings that hardens into shields around everyone beneath them
powers.cost: The light fades whenever she doubts the person she is protecting
powers.prom: Her family has quietly bought the ballroom and only "suitable" guests will be shielded.

powers.name: Rapport
powers.action: make anyone nearby feel they have known him for years
powers.cost: He can never be sure anyone likes him without it
powers.prom: Half the guests have been charmed into guarding the villain's machinery.

powers.name: Thermite Gauntlet
powers.action: cut through steel, cauterize wounds and weld collapsing structures shut
powers.cost: Fuel cells are expensive, and she is always one bill away from empty
powers.prom: The ballroom doors have been welded shut from the outside.

powers.name: Jetstream Suit
powers.action: fly faster than anything in the city and scatter a cloud of tiny rescue drones
powers.cost: The battery lasts eleven minutes, and he always knows how many are left
powers.prom: A drone swarm circles the glass roof, waiting for the signal to dive.

powers.name: Groundbreaker Rig
powers.action: pilot a heavy exoframe that digs, lifts and raises instant earthworks
powers.cost: The rig is slow, loud and impossible to hide
powers.prom: The ballroom support columns were poured hollow by a contractor she already suspects.

powers.name: Pressure Suit
powers.action: dive to any depth and blast high-pressure water jets
powers.cost: Every deep dive leaves her with days of decompression pain
powers.prom: A pumping station beneath the pier is filling the sealed ballroom basement.

powers.name: Spring-Steel Legs
powers.action: leap three stories, kick through walls and sprint faster than a motorbike
powers.cost: Phantom pain flares whenever he pushes past his limits
powers.prom: A uniformed militia has quietly replaced the ballroom security staff.

powers.name: F.R.O.G. Leap Rig
powers.action: hurl across buildings with spring-loaded boots, deploy adhesive rescue pads and use a brilliant human mind to reconfigure biotech gear
powers.cost: the gear overheats at high velocity, and the unfinished serum tempts Dr. Frog to replace the patient inventor with a mutated superbeing
powers.prom: The ballroom roof buckles while Lionel's leap rig can anchor the falling chandelier; an untested serum offers an easier but irreversible leap.

powers.name: Legacy Armor
powers.action: deploy a different gadget from a gleaming flight suit for every situation
powers.cost: Everything the suit does is billed to his family, and they keep receipts
powers.prom: Sterling Dynamics prototype turrets are installed in the ballroom balconies.

powers.name: Livestream
powers.action: film, fact-check and broadcast anything in real time to a million followers
powers.cost: Everything they see becomes public, including their friends' worst moments
powers.prom: Every phone in the ballroom is broadcasting a doctored video of the evacuation as a massacre.

powers.name: Salamander's Bargain
powers.action: summon living flame-spirits that light the way and burn only what she names
powers.cost: The salamander speaks through her at the worst possible moments
powers.prom: Every candle on every table is a wick of the same ancient fire.

powers.name: Stormsong
powers.action: call wind, lightning and rain with sung words of power
powers.cost: Every song steals his voice for a day
powers.prom: A storm is building inside the ballroom, under the glass roof.

powers.name: Granny's Rune Needles
powers.action: stitch buildings into moving shelters, command pavement to rise, and knit enormous magical wards with devastating grandmotherly precision
powers.cost: each protective stitch binds part of the neighborhood to Granny Mayhem's personal will, and a rescue can become an unwanted curfew
powers.prom: A quilt of enchanted cobblestones starts pulling the ballroom apart; Granny's needlework can shelter everyone or trap the entire city in her rules.

powers.name: Scrying Pool
powers.action: see through any water surface in the city and step through it like a doorway
powers.cost: The bowl shows him his own death more often than anyone else's
powers.prom: The punch bowl shows him every guest dying in a different order.

powers.name: Iron Palm
powers.action: channel inner force into strikes that shatter stone and a touch that soothes pain
powers.cost: Every strike drains her, and she must meditate to recover
powers.prom: Silent monks have taken the ballroom doors and will not let anyone leave without permission.

powers.name: Sigilcraft
powers.action: draw glowing formula-sigils that hold doors open, stop bullets or summon helpers
powers.cost: One error in the math turns the sigil against him
powers.prom: The dance-floor tiles have been arranged into a sigil that needs one more step to close.

powers.name: The Grimoire
powers.action: cast a different ancestor's spell from every page of the family grimoire
powers.cost: Each spell carries its author's temper and old grudges
powers.prom: The city's oldest ward is anchored beneath the ballroom, and someone is tearing it out.

powers.name: Showstopper
powers.action: cast glamours that charm crowds, disguise faces and conjure stunning illusions
powers.cost: The crossroads spirit is listening to every promise he makes
powers.prom: The ballroom is a glamour; the real room has no doors at all.

powers.name: Solar Core
powers.action: absorb sunlight and release it as blinding heat and hard light
powers.cost: On cloudy days she grows weak and cold
powers.prom: An orbital mirror is focused on the ballroom roof, waiting for dawn.

powers.name: Cloudform
powers.action: become living vapor that slips through cracks, lifts people on soft winds and condenses into a storm
powers.cost: In dry air they lose cohesion and forget who they are
powers.prom: A treaty signed in the ballroom will hand the sky to an armada at midnight.

powers.name: Crystal Lattice
powers.action: grow living crystal walls, bridges and armor out of his own body
powers.cost: Every crystal that breaks takes some of his memory with it
powers.prom: The ballroom chandelier is a crystal seed that will grow through anyone beneath it.

powers.name: Tidecaller
powers.action: call sea creatures to her aid, read the tides and shape seawater into currents
powers.cost: Away from salt water too long, she fades and cannot speak
powers.prom: A whirlpool is opening under the pier ballroom, and something is coming through it.

powers.name: Koala Blade Oath
powers.action: vault through surveillance drones, deliver precise nonlethal katana strikes, and find impossible paths through extradimensional portals
powers.cost: the assassin guild can invoke an old oath and deliver an execution warrant, forcing Zuzu to choose between tradition and his new family
powers.prom: A portal opens above the ballroom and the guild's kill warrant names an innocent guest; Zuzu can cut the warrant or carry it out.

powers.name: Xenotech
powers.action: build impossible devices from household parts: gravity clamps, teleport tags, translation patches
powers.cost: His inventions run on rules this universe barely follows and fail at random
powers.prom: The ballroom generator runs on alien physics that will fail in a very loud way.

powers.name: Royal Seal
powers.action: command beings from her dimension, open royal gateways and wear the crown's armor of light
powers.cost: Every gateway she opens tells the usurper where she is
powers.prom: The ballroom mirrors have become gateways, and the usurper's guard is stepping through.

powers.name: Hivelink
powers.action: connect minds into a temporary shared network for perfect teamwork
powers.cost: Each link leaves fragments of other people's feelings behind
powers.prom: The dancers start moving in perfect unison, and none of them chose to.

powers.name: Mindflame
powers.action: ignite, steer and extinguish fire with her thoughts
powers.cost: Strong emotions start fires whether she wants them or not
powers.prom: Someone has slipped her medication into the punch so her power will burst at the worst moment.

powers.name: Featherweight
powers.action: lift themselves and others on invisible currents of thought
powers.cost: Lifting too much brings nosebleeds and lost time
powers.prom: The whole ballroom floor begins to rise toward the broken glass roof.

powers.name: Stone Memory
powers.action: read the history of any building or stone, and shift the ground with his mind
powers.cost: He hears every crime ever committed in a place, all at once
powers.prom: The ballroom was built over a crime, and its stones are screaming loud enough to crack.

powers.name: Tidal Mind
powers.action: move water by feeling, and sense people's emotions like weather
powers.cost: He soaks up other people's sadness until he is drowning in it
powers.prom: Panic in the ballroom is feeding a wave building in the harbor outside.

powers.name: Mindful Strike
powers.action: predict every move a fighter makes a heartbeat before they make it
powers.cost: She cannot switch it off, and every conversation feels like a fight
powers.prom: A masked fighter among the guests moves exactly the way her old teacher did.

powers.name: Total Recall
powers.action: read minds, borrow skills and remember everything anyone nearby has ever known
powers.cost: Other people's memories crowd out his own
powers.prom: Every guest's darkest secret is about to be read aloud over the ballroom speakers.

powers.name: Prophecy
powers.action: receive visions of possible futures and see the strings that tie people to their fates
powers.cost: Visions arrive uninvited, and she cannot always tell them from memories
powers.prom: It is exactly the night she foresaw, down to the song that is playing.

powers.name: Grapevine
powers.action: hear the surface thoughts of everyone in a room and gently nudge the mood of a crowd
powers.cost: She always knows exactly what people think of her
powers.prom: A rumor races through the ballroom that the exits are trapped, and half the crowd believes it.
